title: China-to-Myanmar Power Tool Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: Electrical Safety and Myanmar Grid Suitability
rows.target_requirement: Myanmar uses a 230 V, 50 Hz supply. Power tools and chargers should be documented for Myanmar voltage, plug, insulation, thermal, charger, and user-safety conditions. MSTRD standards practice is commonly based on adopted IEC standards, so IEC 60745 or IEC 62841 evidence is the practical safety anchor for power tools when conformity documentation is requested.
target_standards: Myanmar Standards Law and MSTRD standards administration
IEC 60745 series for hand-held motor-operated electric tools where still used
IEC 62841 series for hand-held, transportable, and lawn and garden machinery safety
Myanmar 230 V, 50 Hz electricity supply suitability
rows.china_equivalent: China files commonly use the GB 3883 series and CCC baseline where applicable. China is also 50 Hz, but the common nominal supply reference is 220 V or 380 V rather than Myanmar 230 V, so nameplate, charger rating, and heating evidence should be checked for Myanmar use.
china_standards: China 220 V or 380 V, 50 Hz supply assumptions
rows.gap: The main gap is not frequency, because both China and Myanmar use 50 Hz. The practical gap is voltage and evidence mapping: China GB 3883 or CCC material should be mapped to Myanmar 230 V use, IEC 60745 or IEC 62841 safety clauses, charger scope, plug or adapter practice, and any MSTRD conformity request.

target.en: Myanmar standards are largely voluntary, but some product categories or procurement and customs situations may require conformity documentation. Treat MSTRD or importer requests as shipment-critical even where the underlying standard is not generally mandatory.
target.zh: 缅甸标准大多为自愿性质，但部分产品类别或采购、海关情形可能要求符合性文件。即使底层标准并非普遍强制，也应将 MSTRD 或进口商要求视为影响出货的关键事项。
target.zht: 緬甸標準大多為自願性質，但部分產品類別或採購、海關情形可能要求符合性文件。即使底層標準並非普遍強制，也應將 MSTRD 或進口商要求視為影響出貨的關鍵事項。

cn.en: China domestic baseline commonly uses GB 3883, GB 4343 EMC evidence, and CCC where applicable.
cn.zh: 中国境内基线通常采用 GB 3883、GB 4343 EMC 证据及适用的 CCC。
cn.zht: 中國境內基線通常採用 GB 3883、GB 4343 EMC 證據及適用的 CCC。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not shipment-ready until China safety evidence is checked against Myanmar 230 V use, IEC 60745 or IEC 62841 expectations, charger scope, and any MSTRD conformity-document request.

source.publisher: Myanmar Ministry of Science and Technology / MSTRD

rows.target_requirement: Myanmar does not operate an EU-style horizontal EMC CE regime for ordinary power tools, but EMC evidence may still be requested in conformity files, procurement, customs review, or for equipment with chargers and electronic controls. Wireless-enabled tools, connected chargers, Bluetooth modules, Wi-Fi modules, or other radio functions should be screened for MPT telecommunications or radio requirements before import.
target_standards: MSTRD conformity-document practice for relevant electrical products
MPT telecommunications and radio oversight for wireless-enabled equipment
IEC or CISPR based EMC evidence where requested
rows.china_equivalent: China export packages commonly include GB 4343 EMC reports together with GB 3883 safety reports and CCC baseline evidence where applicable. Those reports are useful starting evidence but do not automatically answer Myanmar importer, MSTRD, customs, or MPT radio questions.
rows.gap: The gap is usually scope classification. A wired drill with no radio may only need EMC evidence as supporting documentation, while a Bluetooth or Wi-Fi enabled tool or charger can trigger MPT screening. China EMC reports should identify tested configurations, chargers, battery packs, electronic controllers, and radio modules.

target.en: Myanmar standards are largely voluntary for ordinary tools, but MPT screening should be treated as mandatory for radio or wireless functions. EMC evidence may become practically required by importers, projects, customs, or conformity-document requests.
target.zh: 对于普通工具，缅甸标准大多为自愿性质；但无线电或无线功能应将 MPT 筛查视为强制性事项。EMC 证据可能因进口商、项目、海关或符合性文件要求而成为实务必需。
target.zht: 對於普通工具，緬甸標準大多為自願性質；但無線電或無線功能應將 MPT 篩查視為強制性事項。EMC 證據可能因進口商、項目、海關或符合性文件要求而成為實務必需。

cn.en: China domestic baseline commonly uses GB 4343 EMC evidence alongside GB 3883 safety evidence and CCC where applicable.
cn.zh: 中国境内基线通常在 GB 3883 安全证据之外采用 GB 4343 EMC 证据及适用的 CCC。
cn.zht: 中國境內基線通常在 GB 3883 安全證據之外採用 GB 4343 EMC 證據及適用的 CCC。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Conditionally ready only after the tool is classified as non-radio or radio-enabled, China EMC evidence is mapped to the marketed configuration, and any MPT wireless review is closed before import.

rows.requirement: Myanmar Market Access, Standards, and Import Route
rows.target_requirement: Power tools entering Myanmar should be prepared for MSTRD standards or conformity-document questions, MIC touchpoints where the shipment is tied to investment or project activity, and customs processing through routes such as Yangon, Thilawa, or Mandalay overland from Yunnan. Myanmar standards are largely voluntary, but selected categories or transactions can require conformity documentation.
target_standards: MSTRD Myanmar standards and conformity-document practice
MIC investment and project approval touchpoints where applicable
Myanmar customs import processing for Yangon, Thilawa, Mandalay, and overland routes
IEC 60745 or IEC 62841 based power-tool safety evidence where requested
rows.china_equivalent: China domestic files commonly rely on GB 3883, GB 4343 EMC evidence, factory declarations, and CCC baseline where applicable. These help build the Myanmar file but do not replace importer classification, customs documents, MSTRD conformity requests, or MIC project requirements.
rows.gap: The common gap is assuming that a China domestic compliance pack is enough for Myanmar entry. The Myanmar pack should identify the importer of record, route, invoice and HS classification, voltage suitability, IEC safety mapping, wireless status, and whether the sale is tied to a MIC-approved investment or project.

target.en: Myanmar standards are largely voluntary, but conformity documents can be required for some categories, buyers, project channels, or customs cases. MIC involvement is context-specific and should be screened when imports support investment or project operations.
target.zh: 缅甸标准大多为自愿性质，但某些类别、买方、项目渠道或海关个案可能要求符合性文件。MIC 介入取决于具体情境，当进口支持投资或项目运营时应进行筛查。
target.zht: 緬甸標準大多為自願性質，但某些類別、買方、項目渠道或海關個案可能要求符合性文件。MIC 介入取決於具體情境，當進口支援投資或項目運營時應進行篩查。

cn.en: China domestic baseline evidence does not establish Myanmar import clearance or project approval by itself.
cn.zh: 中国境内基线证据本身不能构成缅甸进口清关或项目批准。
cn.zht: 中國境內基線證據本身不能構成緬甸進口清關或項目批准。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Myanmar-entry ready until the importer confirms route, customs documents, MSTRD conformity-document expectations, voltage and IEC safety mapping, wireless status, and any MIC project linkage.

source.publisher: Directorate of Investment and Company Administration / Myanmar Investment Commission

rows.target_requirement: Myanmar does not have an EU-style outdoor equipment noise directive for power tools. Noise handling is mainly a national workplace health and safety or buyer-specification issue, so import files should provide product sound data, instructions, hearing-protection warnings, and project-specific OHS support where requested.
target_standards: Myanmar workplace health and safety obligations where applicable
Buyer or project OHS specifications for construction and industrial use
IEC 60745 or IEC 62841 noise and vibration information where used in the safety file
rows.china_equivalent: China GB 3883 files may include noise and vibration data for instructions or safety review, but they do not create a Myanmar-specific outdoor-noise approval because Myanmar has no horizontal EU-like outdoor noise regime for these tools.
china_standards: China tool noise and vibration data where included in the safety file
rows.gap: The gap is over-importing the EU template. For Myanmar, do not claim an outdoor-noise directive obligation. Instead, keep usable sound data, warnings, and OHS material for workplaces, tenders, or construction projects that request them.

target.en: No known horizontal Myanmar outdoor-noise directive equivalent for power tools. Noise requirements are mainly workplace, project, buyer, or instruction-file matters unless a specific local rule or contract applies.
target.zh: 未见缅甸存在针对电动工具的横向户外噪声指令等同制度。除非适用特定本地规则或合同，噪声要求主要属于工作场所、项目、买方或说明书文件事项。
target.zht: 未見緬甸存在針對電動工具的橫向戶外噪聲指令等同制度。除非適用特定本地規則或合同，噪聲要求主要屬於工作場所、項目、買方或說明書文件事項。

cn.en: China GB 3883 evidence may support user-information and OHS documentation but does not replace Myanmar workplace or project requirements.
cn.zh: 中国 GB 3883 证据可支持用户信息和 OHS 文件，但不能替代缅甸工作场所或项目要求。
cn.zht: 中國 GB 3883 證據可支援用戶資訊和 OHS 文件，但不能替代緬甸工作場所或項目要求。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not apply the EU outdoor-noise row to Myanmar. Treat noise as an OHS, instruction, tender, or project-support issue unless a specific Myanmar rule or contract says otherwise.

rows.target_requirement: Myanmar lacks a horizontal RoHS regime like the EU. For power tools, restricted-substance documentation is mainly a buyer, procurement, brand, destination-project, recycling, or supply-chain requirement rather than a general Myanmar RoHS market-access file.
target_standards: No known horizontal Myanmar RoHS regime for power tools
Buyer or project restricted-substance specifications where applicable
Material declarations and supplier controls as commercial due diligence
rows.china_equivalent: China RoHS material declarations, GB 3883 evidence, and supplier substance controls can support Myanmar buyers, but they should not be re-labelled as satisfying a Myanmar horizontal RoHS law.
rows.gap: The gap is treating Myanmar as if it had the EU RoHS framework. Say plainly that Myanmar lacks a horizontal RoHS regime, then keep material declarations available for buyers, tenders, brands, and downstream markets that ask for them.

target.en: No known horizontal Myanmar RoHS obligation for power tools. Substance evidence may be commercially required by buyers or projects.
target.zh: 未见缅甸对电动工具设有横向 RoHS 义务。物质证据可能由买方或项目以商业方式要求。
target.zht: 未見緬甸對電動工具設有橫向 RoHS 義務。物質證據可能由買方或項目以商業方式要求。

cn.en: China RoHS evidence may be useful but is not a Myanmar statutory RoHS substitute.
cn.zh: 中国 RoHS 证据可能有用，但不是缅甸法定 RoHS 的替代物。
cn.zht: 中國 RoHS 證據可能有用，但不是緬甸法定 RoHS 的替代物。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not create a Myanmar RoHS claim from the EU template. Keep China RoHS or supplier declarations only as buyer-support evidence unless a specific Myanmar contract or authority requests them.

source.publisher: Myanmar Ministry of Science and Technology / MSTRD

rows.requirement: Cordless Tool Batteries and Import Documentation
rows.target_requirement: Myanmar does not have an EU-style battery regulation for power-tool battery packs, but lithium battery packs in cordless tools still need practical import, transport, safety, labelling, and buyer documentation. Importers should check customs documents, dangerous-goods transport evidence, charger compatibility, spare-pack packaging, and any project or retailer requirements.
target_standards: Myanmar customs import documentation for batteries and power tools
Lithium battery transport evidence such as UN 38.3 where applicable
IEC 62133 or equivalent battery safety evidence where requested by buyer or project
MSTRD conformity-document practice where requested
rows.china_equivalent: China cordless-tool files often include GB 3883 tool safety evidence, charger reports, battery pack specifications, UN 38.3 transport reports, MSDS or SDS documents, and shipping labels. These should be converted into a Myanmar import pack rather than treated as an automatic market-access approval.
china_standards: UN 38.3 lithium battery transport test evidence
rows.gap: The gap is usually logistics and battery-pack traceability rather than a Myanmar battery CE-style file. Confirm whether batteries are shipped installed, packed with equipment, or separately; align labels, SDS, UN 38.3, charger ratings, and spare-pack documents with the selected route.

target.en: No known horizontal Myanmar battery regulation equivalent to the EU Battery Regulation for these products. Transport, customs, buyer, and project requirements can still be mandatory for the shipment.
target.zh: 未见缅甸对这些产品设有等同欧盟电池法规的横向电池法规。运输、海关、买方和项目要求仍可能对该批货具有强制性。
target.zht: 未見緬甸對這些產品設有等同歐盟電池法規的橫向電池法規。運輸、海關、買方和項目要求仍可能對該批貨具有強制性。

cn.en: China tool, charger, and lithium-battery evidence should be repackaged for Myanmar customs and shipment route requirements.
cn.zh: 中国工具、充电器和锂电池证据应按缅甸海关及运输路径要求重新整理。
cn.zht: 中國工具、充電器和鋰電池證據應按緬甸海關及運輸路徑要求重新整理。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Conditionally ready only after the cordless-tool battery pack is documented for the actual shipping mode, customs route, charger compatibility, transport evidence, and any buyer or project battery requirements.
